what: blaze-core's unit tests did not compile on macOS on main: `driver.poll(&mut out, Duration::from_millis(20))` where `poll` takes a `Deadline`. No macOS test of blaze-core could run.
cost: found only when a macOS check of the new effect was needed
cause: the deadline-waits port missed one test, and nothing compiles macOS test targets
fix: the gate compiles every test target on macOS (rev-1's fix, for macOS too)
